description: Kubernetes workspace: one maximized terminal filling the screen, with k9s, kubectl, kubens and the Argo CD CLI ready. Create ~/.kube/config inside the workspace to connect to a cluster.
notes: No desktop, no panel: the session is a single maximized terminal, and it reopens if closed. Credentials are not included, create ~/.kube/config inside the workspace. Open a second terminal with Ctrl+Shift+T, or run xfce4-terminal & from the shell.
